title: Financial Services
description: WhiteGuard supports financial institutions across MENA, including banks, fintechs, insurance providers, leasing companies, payment providers, and other regulated financial organizations.

hero.headline: Financial services cybersecurity
hero.intro: Financial services cybersecurity is what stands between a regulated balance sheet and the next headline breach. WhiteGuard delivers financial services cybersecurity programs across MENA, powered by WhiteHawk's four integrated modules: Offensive Security, Defensive Security, Asset Management, and GRC.

bullets: Built for banks, fintechs, insurers, leasing, and payments.
Covers offensive, defensive, asset, and GRC needs.
Helps monitor threats and maintain compliance.

seo.title: Financial Services | WhiteGuard
seo.description: Cybersecurity for banks, fintech, insurance, and regulated finance across MENA.

bankingCybersecuritySection.heading: Banking cybersecurity
paragraphs: Financial cybersecurity covers more than banks. Insurers, leasing operators (A.T. Lease, Enmaa Finance, OLIV Finance), payment providers (easycash), and the fintechs connecting to all of them sit inside the same regulatory perimeter.

WhiteGuard treats financial cybersecurity as one continuous program, measured by WhiteHawk's verified <200 ms telemetry processing latency, 40% MTTR reduction, and 30% lower total cost of ownership than traditional consultancies. Cyber security in financial sector environments is a business-continuity guarantee, not a back-office cost.

insuranceCybersecurityBand.headline: Insurance Cybersecurity
insuranceCybersecurityBand.body: Insurance cybersecurity protects highly sensitive customer, financial, and claims data from fraud, ransomware, and operational disruption. WhiteGuard supports insurers with continuous monitoring, compliance alignment, access control, and risk management programs designed for modern insurance and digital-claims environments across MENA.
